    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">老旧办公电脑安装Linux系统（1）——初步印象</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>老旧办公电脑安装Linux系统笔记</p>
<p>有一批老旧电脑，配置大体是6-8代的i3、i5，4G内存，1T机械硬盘。使用以办公软件（WPS)为主，传输文件通信以微信为主。偶尔浏览网页查资料，播放音视频。Windows系统广告泛滥，严重影响性能，寻求Linux解决方案。目标是“开箱即用”，经过简单配置即可投入使用。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 18px">第一阶段&nbsp; 虚拟机环境测试</span></strong></p>
<p>（1）Deepin15.11测试&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;初步印象：界面美观，预装搜狗输入法、WPS。安装微信Linux版本（deb包）后，无法运行。AppImage版本依旧无法运行。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="888" height="513" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260924170925692-1711009224.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="image" width="888" height="251" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260924165008471-874362288.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260924165520903-1992996439.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;应用商店多次打开都是无法联网。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="888" height="513" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260924170925692-1711009224.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>小结：升级相关依赖项太费事，不符合使用目标。</p>
<p>&nbsp;（2）Deepin20.9测试&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-09-28-11-29-18" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260928163553619-1593943455.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-09-28-16-32-34" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260928163642268-580001743.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;初步印象：界面美观，和15.11一样，官方不再支持，应用商店和默认更新源似乎均不再支持。微信、WPS、Firefox均需手动更新。运行速度不是很快。</p>
<p>（3）优麒麟ubuntukylin-20.04-pro-sp1-amd64测试&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-09-28-19-02-48" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260929104420849-1580322252.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>初步印象：预装WPS、中文化可操作性和Deepin差不多，速度比Deepin20略快。手动安装微信可运行。自动更新大小2G左右，可选Ubuntu更新源。</p>
<p>（4）linuxmint-20.3-xfce-64bit测试&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-09-29-12-36-02" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202609/816998-20260930100704985-423524459.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;初步印象：支持部分更新，安装WPS、微信简单，运行速度较快。界面略显简单。</p>
<p>（5）xubuntu-20.04.6-desktop-amd64测试&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-10-09-10-36-14" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202610/816998-20261009164241957-1413339659.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>初步印象：界面略显简单，运行速度较快。</p>
<p>（6）openKylin-1.0.2-x86_64测试&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="老旧机型Linux-2026-10-09-11-10-24" width="888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/816998/202610/816998-20261009165014690-135111773.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;初步印象：界面美观，开始菜单分类不是很直观，响应速度快。中文化友好，配置简单，占用资源较多。</p>

</div>
